description: Moderate antenna icing — ~4 dB gain loss. Range-independent hardware degradation.
_physics: Antenna hardware degradation from ice buildup. NOT a path propagation effect. Flat Pd reduction at all ranges. No weather clutter.
_rate_guide: rain_rate_mmhr is reinterpreted as icing severity: 5=light rime (~2dB loss) | 15=moderate glaze (~4dB) | 30=severe (~6dB)
